HIPPS: A Real 2oo3 Voting Example

HIPPS is a real, worked example of this exact architecture task: three pressure transmitters in 2oo3 voting, feeding a logic solver, driving two redundant final control elements — explicitly framed in the source as meeting SIL 3. Walking why 2oo3 (not 1oo2, not a single transmitter) meets that target is the model for the module's own architecture exercise. Component Index: cvh-cmp-hipps-typical-configuration.
